name: Stale cards nudge
summary: Find cards nobody has touched for a while and propose a friendly nudge comment for each one.

routes.how: Read the local board and source files

flow.title: Once a day
flow.text: Runs on the shared automation schedule.

flow.title: Read the board
flow.text: Looks at open cards and their last activity.

flow.title: Find stale cards
flow.text: A small script lists cards the board marks for attention. No AI is used.

flow.title: Write a nudge
flow.text: An agent drafts a short, polite nudge for each card, once per card per week.

flow.title: Review Inbox
flow.text: Each nudge waits there as a proposal. Nothing is posted until you accept it.
